turns.user: Explain why a load balancer sends requests to several servers.
turns.assistant:
**Answer**
A load balancer sends each request to one of several servers so work is shared instead of piling onto a single machine.

**Why**
One server can only handle so much traffic at once. If every request hits the same server, it slows down or fails when demand spikes.

Spreading requests across multiple servers raises total capacity. If one server fails, others can still answer requests.

That keeps the service faster and more reliable under heavy use.
